entities.name: Márton Stromgald
entities.description: Legendary Kjeldoran general of the Ice Age, later reanimated as a zombie by Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer who reanimated Stromgald and used him as a puppet.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: Order founded by Lim-Dûl using the reanimated Stromgald.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Encountered Stromgald atop a parapet in Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Place where Stromgald appeared through a magical apparition.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor against whom a rebellion was incited.

entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: Servant of Lim-Dûl whose lost arm was replaced by Stromgald's sword arm.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Realm Stromgald served as general and hero.

events.summary: Stromgald leads Lim-Dûl's squadron into defeat against a goblin horde, leaving Lim-Dûl the only survivor.
events.quote: he led Lim-Dûl 's squadron into defeat in battle against a horde of goblins , with Lim-Dûl as the only survivor.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl reanimates Stromgald as a zombie and uses him to found the Order of Stromgald.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl later reanimated him as a zombie and used him to found the Order of Stromgald .

events.summary: Jodah meets Stromgald atop a parapet in Tresserhorn and learns of his undead nature.
events.quote: Jodah encountered Stromgald atop a parapet in Tresserhorn

events.summary: Stromgald is used as a symbol to incite a failed rebellion against King Darien in Krov.
events.quote: being used as a symbol to incite a rebellion against king Darien

events.summary: Lim-Dûl dismantles Stromgald and uses his sword arm to replace Chaeska's lost one.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl had no more use for Stromgald and dismantled him

relations.note: Controls the reanimated Stromgald as a puppet.
relations.quote: he was unable to prevent Lim-Dûl using his body as a puppet
